### Summary / 需求概述
Briefly describe the feature or improvement you would like to see.
简要描述您希望增加的功能或改进。

### Use Case / 适用场景
Explain when this feature is needed and what moderation or community workflow problem it solves.
说明该功能在什么情况下会被使用，能解决哪些服务器管理或社区协作问题。

### Design Proposal (Optional) / 方案设计（可选）
- Command design, permission nodes, and target-selector boundaries / 命令设计、权限节点与目标选择边界
- Coordination with `permissions`, `ServerFixes`, or companion plugins / 与伴随插件的协同策略
- Potential edge cases / 潜在边界情况
